places.name: Historic Center of Olinda (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The Historic Center of Olinda is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its colorful colonial architecture, cobblestone streets, and vibrant cultural scene.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for safety.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour to learn about the history and culture of the area.

places.name: Recife Antigo District
places.ai_summary: Recife Antigo is the historic district of Recife, featuring colonial buildings, cultural landmarks, and a lively nightlife scene.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the evening for the nightlife.

places.place_tip: Explore the local bars and restaurants for a taste of Recife’s cuisine.

places.name: Marco Zero Square
places.ai_summary: Marco Zero Square is the cultural and historical heart of Recife, featuring vibrant art installations and a starting point for exploring the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the evening for the illuminated art installations.

places.place_tip: Take a photo with the colorful sculptures in the square.

places.name: Ricardo Brennand Institute
places.ai_summary: The Ricardo Brennand Institute is a cultural institution in Recife, featuring a museum, art gallery, and a library, set in a beautiful park.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the impressive collection of armory and the beautiful park area.
places.address: Rua Ricardo Brennand, s/n - Várzea, Recife - PE, 50720-240, Brazil

places.name: Francisco Brennand Sculpture Park
places.ai_summary: A stunning park in Recife featuring the works of the Brazilian sculptor Francisco Brennand, set in a beautiful landscape.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes for walking around the park.
places.address: Rua Ricardo Brennand, s/n - Várzea, Recife - PE, 50720-240, Brazil

places.name: Boa Viagem Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular urban beach in Recife, known for its natural pools, white sand, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Try the local seafood at the beachside kiosks.

places.name: Cais do Sertão Museum
places.ai_summary: A museum in Recife dedicated to the culture and history of the Brazilian Sertão, featuring interactive exhibits and a rich collection of artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Check out the schedule for cultural presentations and workshops.
places.address: Cais do Sertão, s/n - Recife Antigo, Recife - PE, 50030-230, Brazil

places.name: Convent of São Francisco
places.ai_summary: A historic convent in Olinda, known for its baroque architecture, beautiful church, and serene gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Attend a mass or concert for a unique experience.

places.name: Rua do Amparo Artisan Shops
places.ai_summary: A charming street in Olinda lined with artisan shops, selling handmade crafts, souvenirs, and local art.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Look for unique handmade souvenirs and local artwork.
places.address: Rua do Amparo, Olinda - PE, Brazil

places.name: Casa dos Bonecos Gigantes
places.ai_summary: A cultural space in Olinda dedicated to the giant puppets (bonecos gigantes) of the local carnival, featuring a museum and workshop.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Participate in a workshop to make your own mini giant puppet.

places.name: Olinda Carnival Route
places.ai_summary: The Olinda Carnival Route is famous for its vibrant and colorful carnival parade, featuring giant puppets, music, and dancing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the carnival season (February/March).

places.place_tip: Join the locals in the street for an authentic carnival experience.

places.name: Museu do Homem do Nordeste
places.ai_summary: A museum in Recife dedicated to the culture, history, and people of the Brazilian Northeast, featuring a rich collection of artifacts and exhibits.
places.name_english: Museum of the Man of the Northeast

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 17:00.

places.place_tip: Explore the museum's garden for a peaceful retreat.
places.address: Avenida Rui Barbosa, 960 - Boa Vista, Recife - PE, 50050-901, Brazil

places.name: Embaixada dos Bonecos Gigantes
places.ai_summary: The Embassy of Giant Puppets is a cultural space in Olinda showcasing the giant puppets of the local carnival, with exhibits and workshops.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Join a workshop to learn about the art of puppet making.

places.name: Pina Beach
places.ai_summary: A popular beach in Recife, known for its clear waters, coral reefs, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Bring snorkeling gear to explore the coral reefs.

places.name: Praia do Paiva
places.ai_summary: A beautiful beach located south of Recife, known for its clear waters, natural pools, and tranquil environment.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day.

places.place_tip: Visit the natural pools at low tide for the best experience.
places.address: Praia do Paiva, Cabo de Santo Agostinho - PE, Brazil

places.name: Recife Bridge of Sighs
places.ai_summary: A historic bridge in Recife, offering a scenic view of the Capibaribe River and the city’s skyline.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for the sunset view.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera for stunning photos of the sunset.

places.name: Olinda Panoramic Viewpoint
places.ai_summary: A scenic viewpoint in Olinda, offering a panoramic view of the city, the coastline, and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit early to avoid the heat and enjoy the view.

places.name: Oficina Cerâmica Francisco Brennand
places.ai_summary: A ceramic workshop and studio in Recife, founded by the artist Francisco Brennand, featuring unique ceramic pieces and a beautiful garden.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last admission at 16:30.

places.place_tip: Explore the gardens and the unique ceramic art installations.
places.address: Rua Ricardo Brennand, s/n - Várzea, Recife - PE, 50720-240, Brazil

places.name: Shopping RioMar Recife
places.ai_summary: A modern shopping mall in Recife, featuring a wide range of shops, restaurants, and entertainment options.

opening_hours.notes: Check the website for holiday hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the food court for a variety of dining options.
places.address: Av. República do Líbano, 251 - Pina, Recife - PE, 51130-000, Brazil
